Context
The ElixirTrials system extracts and grounds clinical trial eligibility criteria from PDF protocols using a two-model architecture (Gemini for structured extraction, MedGemma for medical reasoning). Three new features are needed:

A Jupyter notebook demonstrating the pipeline end-to-end
A beautiful spreadsheet page in the frontend for viewing structured criteria
A unified inference gateway that abstracts local (Ollama) and remote (Gemini/Vertex) model backends behind a single API


Feature 1: Jupyter Notebook — Criteria Extraction & Grounding Demo
New files

notebooks/criteria_extraction_demo.ipynb — Main demo notebook (7 sections)
notebooks/sample_data/README.md — Instructions for placing sample PDFs

Notebook structure (7 cell groups)

Setup — Load .env via python-dotenv, add workspace src/ paths to sys.path, verify GOOGLE_API_KEY is set
PDF Ingestion — Load sample PDF with pathlib, show page count and metadata via pymupdf
Extraction — Call extract_criteria_structured(pdf_bytes, protocol_id, title) from protocol_processor.tools.gemini_extractor, parse result into ExtractionResult, display as pandas DataFrame
Rich Criteria Display — Iterate criteria showing type badges, temporal constraints, numeric thresholds, confidence histogram (matplotlib)
Entity Grounding — For selected criteria, use TerminologyRouter.route_entity() for candidates then medgemma_decide() for selection. Display EntityGroundingResult with candidate comparison table
Expression Tree — Visualize StructuredCriterionTree as indented text tree with unicode box-drawing characters (graphviz optional)
Field Mappings — Display Entity | Relation | Value | Unit tables

Key decisions

Import workspace modules directly (not REST API calls) — launched via uv run jupyter notebook
No database required — uses extraction/grounding tools as pure functions
Graceful degradation when MedGemma unavailable (shows candidates without decision step)

Dependencies to add

matplotlib and pandas to root pyproject.toml dev dependencies (for notebook display)

Key files reused

services/protocol-processor-service/src/protocol_processor/tools/gemini_extractor.py — extract_criteria_structured()
services/protocol-processor-service/src/protocol_processor/tools/medgemma_decider.py — medgemma_decide()
services/protocol-processor-service/src/protocol_processor/tools/terminology_router.py — TerminologyRouter
services/protocol-processor-service/src/protocol_processor/schemas/extraction.py — ExtractionResult, ExtractedCriterion
services/protocol-processor-service/src/protocol_processor/schemas/grounding.py — EntityGroundingResult
services/protocol-processor-service/src/protocol_processor/schemas/structure.py — StructuredCriterionTree, ExpressionNode


Feature 2: Frontend Structured Criteria Spreadsheet Page
New backend files

services/api-service/src/api_service/criteria_table.py — New APIRouter(prefix="/criteria", tags=["criteria-table"]) with:

GET /criteria/structured — Paginated, filterable, sortable endpoint returning structured criteria across all protocols
Response model: StructuredCriterionRow (id, protocol_title, text, criteria_type, category, confidence, assertion_status, entities with grounding codes, field_mappings, structured_criterion tree, review_status)
Query params: page, page_size, criteria_type, category, protocol_id, min_confidence, sort_by, sort_order, has_grounding


Register router in services/api-service/src/api_service/main.py

New frontend files

apps/hitl-ui/src/screens/CriteriaSpreadsheet.tsx — Main page with filter bar + table + stats summary
apps/hitl-ui/src/hooks/useCriteriaSpreadsheet.ts — React Query hook for GET /criteria/structured
apps/hitl-ui/src/components/criteria-table/CriteriaTable.tsx — TanStack Table wrapper with beautiful styling
apps/hitl-ui/src/components/criteria-table/columns.tsx — Column definitions (11 columns)
apps/hitl-ui/src/components/criteria-table/ExpressionTreeCell.tsx — Inline recursive tree renderer for AND/OR/NOT logic
apps/hitl-ui/src/components/criteria-table/FieldMappingCell.tsx — Entity-Relation-Value-Unit compact pill display
apps/hitl-ui/src/components/criteria-table/ConfidenceBadge.tsx — Color-gradient confidence indicator
apps/hitl-ui/src/components/criteria-table/filters.tsx — Filter chip components

Modified frontend files

apps/hitl-ui/src/App.tsx — Add /criteria route with RequireAuth wrapper
Header navigation — Add "Criteria" link alongside existing nav items

Table columns

Criterion Text — Expandable, truncated to 100 chars
Type — inclusion/exclusion with color badges (green/red)
Category — Groupable (medical_history, lab_values, medications, procedures, other)
Entities — Entity badges with grounding codes (reuse TerminologyBadge component)
Field Mappings — E|R|V|U pill format (reuse FieldMappingBadges logic)
Expression Tree — Collapsible inline tree (AND/OR/NOT + ATOMIC leaves)

Smooth row hover animations with subtle background transitions
Animated confidence bars (CSS transitions)
Expandable row detail panel with full criterion text + expression tree
Filter chips with animated add/remove
Column resize handles with smooth cursor feedback
Sticky header with blur-backdrop
Row grouping with collapsible category sections

apps/hitl-ui/src/components/TerminologyBadge.tsx — Entity grounding display

Feature 3: Unified Inference Gateway with Ollama Support
Architecture: Provider-Agnostic API Layer
The user wants a unified backend API where the application always talks to the same endpoints (/files, /responses), and a routing layer maps logical model names to provider-specific adapters. This is more than a setup script — it's an inference gateway.

scripts/validate-model-endpoint.py — Health check: test MedGemma grounding endpoint, test extraction endpoint, print status table

ollama_model (default medgemma or gemma2)
ollama_extraction_model (default qwen2.5:14b or similar capable model)

services/protocol-processor-service/src/protocol_processor/tools/gemini_extractor.py — Add gateway integration: when LOCAL_EXTRACTION_ENABLED=true, route through InferenceGateway instead of direct google.genai.Client
services/protocol-processor-service/src/protocol_processor/tools/gemini_utils.py — Extend create_structured_llm() to return an Ollama-backed LLM when GOOGLE_API_KEY is not set but OLLAMA_BASE_URL is configured

Gateway API design
pythonclass BaseAdapter(ABC):
    """Provider-agnostic inference adapter."""

    async def upload_file(self, file_bytes: bytes, filename: str) -> str:
        """Upload file, return file_id. Remote adapters use provider File API.
        Local adapters store to disk and return local file_id."""

    async def generate(self, file_id: str | None, input_text: str,
                       system_prompt: str) -> str:
        """Generate text response. For remote: passes provider file_id in request.
        For local: retrieves stored file, extracts text, feeds to LLM."""

    async def generate_structured(self, file_id: str | None, input_text: str,
                                   system_prompt: str,
                                   output_schema: type[BaseModel]) -> BaseModel:
        """Generate structured output. Remote: native structured output.
        Local: JSON mode + Pydantic validation."""


class ModelRouter:
    """Routes logical model names to adapters based on config."""

    def __init__(self, config: dict[str, AdapterConfig]):
        # e.g. {"extraction": GeminiAdapter(...), "grounding": OllamaAdapter(...)}

    def get_adapter(self, role: str) -> BaseAdapter: ...


class InferenceGateway:
    """Unified entry point. App code uses this, never provider SDKs directly."""

    def __init__(self, router: ModelRouter, file_store: FileStore): ...

    async def upload_file(self, file_bytes: bytes, filename: str) -> str:
        """Store file in file_store, return gateway file_id."""

    async def generate(self, role: str, file_id: str | None,
                       input_text: str, system_prompt: str) -> str:
        """Route to appropriate adapter by role."""

    async def generate_structured(self, role: str, ...) -> BaseModel:
        """Route to appropriate adapter for structured output."""
```

### Local adapter flow (Ollama)

1. `upload_file()` → Save PDF bytes to local temp storage, return `file_id` (UUID)
2. `generate()` with `file_id` → Retrieve PDF bytes → Extract text via `pymupdf4llm.to_markdown()` → Send text + system prompt to `ollama.chat()` → Return response
3. `generate_structured()` → Same as above but request `format: "json"` from Ollama and validate with Pydantic schema

### Remote adapter flow (Gemini)

1. `upload_file()` → Upload to Gemini File API via `client.files.upload()`, store mapping `gateway_file_id → gemini_file_name`
2. `generate()` with `file_id` → Look up `gemini_file_name` → Call `client.models.generate_content(contents=[gemini_file, prompt])`
3. `generate_structured()` → Same with `response_schema=output_schema`

### Setup script flow (`scripts/setup-local-models.sh`)
```
1. Detect hardware (NVIDIA GPU / Apple Silicon / CPU)
2. Check if Ollama is installed
3. Install Ollama if needed (brew install ollama / curl)
4. Start ollama serve (background)
5. Pull models:
   - For grounding: attempt medgemma conversion, fall back to gemma2:9b
   - For extraction: pull qwen2.5:14b or llama3.1:8b (capable of JSON mode)
6. Write configuration to .env.local:
   MODEL_BACKEND=ollama
   OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434
   OLLAMA_MODEL=gemma2:9b
   OLLAMA_EXTRACTION_MODEL=qwen2.5:14b
   LOCAL_EXTRACTION_ENABLED=true
7. Run validation script

langchain-openai>=0.2.0 — For OpenAI-compatible vLLM adapter (future)
pymupdf4llm>=0.2.9 — Already present, used for local PDF text extraction

MedGemma availability note
MedGemma 4B-IT is a gated HuggingFace model not available in Ollama's library. The script will:

Attempt GGUF conversion if user has HF access (llama.cpp convert_hf_to_gguf.py)
Fall back to gemma2:9b (Google's open model, good medical knowledge) as default
Document how to add MedGemma once GGUF becomes available

1→"""Configuration for MedGemma-based agents.
     2→
     3→This module is shared across services to keep env var semantics consistent.
     4→"""
     5→
     6→from __future__ import annotations
     7→
     8→import os
     9→from dataclasses import dataclass
    10→
    11→
    12→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    13→class AgentConfig:
    14→    """Configuration for MedGemma agent infrastructure.
    15→
    16→    Attributes:
    17→        backend: Model backend selection ("local" or "vertex").
    18→        model_path: HuggingFace model ID or local path.
    19→        quantization: Quantization level ("4bit", "8bit", or "none").
    20→        max_new_tokens: Maximum tokens generated for a single call.
    21→        gcp_project_id: GCP project ID (required for Vertex backend).
    22→        gcp_region: GCP region (required for Vertex backend).
    23→        vertex_endpoint_id: Vertex AI endpoint ID (required for Vertex backend).
    24→        vertex_model_name: Vertex model name (optional alternative to endpoint).
    25→        vertex_endpoint_url: Dedicated endpoint URL (optional, auto-detected).
    26→    """
    27→
    28→    backend: str = "local"
    29→    model_path: str = "google/medgemma-4b-it"
    30→    quantization: str = "4bit"
    31→    max_new_tokens: int = 4096
    32→    gcp_project_id: str = ""
    33→    gcp_region: str = "europe-west4"
    34→    vertex_endpoint_id: str = ""
    35→    vertex_model_name: str = ""
    36→    vertex_endpoint_url: str = ""
    37→
    38→    @property
    39→    def supports_tools(self) -> bool:
    40→        """Check if the configured model backend supports native tool calling."""
    41→        if self.backend != "vertex":
    42→            return False
    43→        return bool(self.vertex_model_name)
    44→
    45→    @classmethod
    46→    def from_env(cls) -> "AgentConfig":
    47→        """Create AgentConfig from environment variables."""
    48→        raw_backend = (
    49→            os.getenv("MODEL_BACKEND") or os.getenv("MEDGEMMA_BACKEND") or "local"
    50→        ).strip()
    51→        backend = raw_backend.lower()
    52→        if backend not in {"local", "vertex"}:
    53→            backend = "local"
    54→
    55→        raw_max_tokens = os.getenv("MEDGEMMA_MAX_TOKENS", "2048")
    56→        try:
    57→            max_tokens = int(raw_max_tokens)
    58→        except ValueError:
    59→            max_tokens = 2048
    60→        if max_tokens <= 0:
    61→            max_tokens = 2048
    62→        return cls(
    63→            backend=backend,
    64→            model_path=os.getenv("MEDGEMMA_MODEL_PATH", cls.model_path),
    65→            quantization=os.getenv("MEDGEMMA_QUANTIZATION", cls.quantization),
    66→            max_new_tokens=max_tokens,
    67→            gcp_project_id=os.getenv("GCP_PROJECT_ID", cls.gcp_project_id),
    68→            gcp_region=os.getenv("GCP_REGION", cls.gcp_region),
    69→            vertex_endpoint_id=os.getenv("VERTEX_ENDPOINT_ID", cls.vertex_endpoint_id),
    70→            vertex_model_name=os.getenv("VERTEX_MODEL_NAME", cls.vertex_model_name),
    71→            vertex_endpoint_url=os.getenv(
    72→                "VERTEX_ENDPOINT_URL", cls.vertex_endpoint_url
    73→            ),
    74→        )
    75→

    45→def _build_gemma_prompt(messages: list[Any]) -> str:

    50→
    51→    Returns:

    53→    """
    54→    prompt_parts = []

    56→        role = "user"
    57→        if msg.type == "ai":

    65→            content = f"### Instruction:\n{content}"

    67→        prompt_parts.append(f"<start_of_turn>{role}\n{content}<end_of_turn>")

    72→def _strip_model_garden_artifacts(text: str, full_prompt: str) -> str:
    73→    """Strip echoed prompts and end-of-turn markers from response.
    74→

    76→    MedGemma's output goes to Gemini, so thinking tokens and other artifacts
    77→    are handled by Gemini's structured output parser.

    83→    # Strip trailing end-of-turn marker
    84→    if text.endswith("<end_of_turn>"):

    90→def _is_retryable_error(exception: BaseException) -> bool:
    91→    """Check if an exception is retryable (transient error).
    92→
    93→    Args:
    94→        exception: The exception to check.
    95→
    96→    Returns:
    97→        True if the exception is retryable, False otherwise.
    98→    """
    99→    # Retry on network/connection errors
   100→    if isinstance(
   101→        exception,
   102→        (
   103→            requests.exceptions.ConnectionError,
   104→            requests.exceptions.Timeout,
   105→            requests.exceptions.ChunkedEncodingError,
   106→        ),
   107→    ):
   108→        return True
   109→
   110→    # Retry on Google API transient server errors
   111→    try:
   112→        from google.api_core import exceptions as google_exceptions
   113→
   114→        if isinstance(
   115→            exception,
   116→            (
   117→                google_exceptions.ServiceUnavailable,
   118→                google_exceptions.InternalServerError,
   119→                google_exceptions.DeadlineExceeded,
   120→                google_exceptions.ResourceExhausted,
   121→            ),
   122→        ):

   127→            exception,
   128→            (
   129→                google_exceptions.PermissionDenied,
   130→                google_exceptions.Unauthenticated,
   131→                google_exceptions.InvalidArgument,
   132→                google_exceptions.NotFound,
   133→                google_exceptions.AlreadyExists,
   134→                google_exceptions.FailedPrecondition,
   135→                google_exceptions.OutOfRange,
   136→            ),
   137→        ):
   138→            return False
   139→    except ImportError:
   140→        pass  # google-api-core not installed; skip Google-specific checks
   141→
   142→    # Do NOT retry on expired credentials — no point retrying with the same creds
   143→    try:
   144→        from google.auth.exceptions import RefreshError
   145→
   146→        if isinstance(exception, RefreshError):

   148→    except ImportError:

   150→
   151→    return False

   161→    endpoint: Any, instances: list[dict[str, Any]], parameters: dict[str, Any]
   162→) -> Any:

   176→class ModelGardenChatModel(BaseChatModel):
   177→    """LangChain ChatModel wrapper for Vertex AI Model Garden endpoints.
   178→
   179→    Wraps a Vertex AI endpoint that serves MedGemma (or other Gemma-family
   180→    models) using the Gemma chat template for prompt formatting and
   181→    exponential-backoff retry for transient errors.
   182→
   183→    The Endpoint object is instantiated once in the constructor and reused
   184→    across calls to enable gRPC channel reuse and avoid per-call overhead.
   185→    """
   186→
   187→    endpoint_resource_name: str
   188→    project: str
   189→    location: str
   190→    max_output_tokens: int = Field(default=8192)
   191→    _endpoint: Any = None
   192→
   193→    def model_post_init(self, __context: Any) -> None:
   194→        """Initialize the Vertex AI Endpoint once for connection reuse."""
   195→        from google.cloud import aiplatform
   196→
   197→        self._endpoint = aiplatform.Endpoint(self.endpoint_resource_name)
   198→
   199→    def _generate(
   200→        self,
   201→        messages: list[BaseMessage],
   202→        stop: list[str] | None = None,
   203→        run_manager: CallbackManagerForLLMRun | None = None,
   204→        **kwargs: Any,
   205→    ) -> ChatResult:
   206→        """Generate a chat response from the Model Garden endpoint.
   207→
   208→        Args:
   209→            messages: List of LangChain messages.
   210→            stop: Optional stop sequences (unused by Model Garden).
   211→            run_manager: Optional callback manager.
   212→            **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments (e.g. temperature).
   213→
   214→        Returns:
   215→            ChatResult containing the model's response.
   216→        """
   217→        endpoint = self._endpoint
   218→
   219→        full_prompt = _build_gemma_prompt(messages)
   220→
   221→        instance = {
   222→            "prompt": full_prompt,
   223→            "max_tokens": self.max_output_tokens,
   224→            "temperature": kwargs.get("temperature", 0.1),
   225→            "top_p": 0.95,
   226→            "top_k": 40,
   227→        }
   228→        parameters = {
   229→            "max_output_tokens": self.max_output_tokens,
   230→            "temperature": kwargs.get("temperature", 0.1),
   231→        }
   232→
   233→        start_time = time.time()
   234→        try:
   235→            logger.debug(
   236→                "Calling Vertex AI endpoint.predict for endpoint: %s",
   237→                self.endpoint_resource_name,
   238→            )
   239→            response = _predict_with_retry(
   240→                endpoint=endpoint, instances=[instance], parameters=parameters
   241→            )
   242→            duration = time.time() - start_time
   243→            logger.debug(
   244→                "Vertex AI endpoint.predict succeeded in %.2f seconds",
   245→                duration,
   246→            )
   247→        except Exception as e:
   248→            duration = time.time() - start_time
   249→            logger.warning(
   250→                "Vertex AI endpoint.predict failed after %.2f seconds: %s",
   251→                duration,
   252→                e,
   253→                exc_info=True,
   254→            )

   259→
   260→        message = AIMessage(content=text)
   261→        generation = ChatGeneration(message=message)
   262→        return ChatResult(generations=[generation])

   299→class LocalMedGemmaChatModel(BaseChatModel):
   300→    """LangChain ChatModel wrapper for locally-loaded MedGemma.
   301→
   302→    Loads google/medgemma-4b-it (or a custom model path) via HuggingFace
   303→    ``transformers`` with optional bitsandbytes quantization. The model
   304→    and tokenizer are loaded once on first call and reused.
   305→
   306→    Requires:
   307→        - NVIDIA GPU with sufficient VRAM (8 GB+ for 4-bit, 16 GB+ for 8-bit)
   308→        - ``torch``, ``transformers``, ``accelerate`` packages
   309→        - ``bitsandbytes`` package (for quantized loading)
   310→    """
   311→
   312→    model_path: str = Field(default="google/medgemma-4b-it")
   313→    quantization: str = Field(default="4bit")
   314→    max_output_tokens: int = Field(default=4096)
   315→    _model: Any = None
   316→    _tokenizer: Any = None
   317→
   318→    def model_post_init(self, __context: Any) -> None:
   319→        """Validate that required packages are available."""
   320→        pass  # Defer actual loading to first call for fast startup
   321→
   322→    def _ensure_loaded(self) -> None:
   323→        """Load model and tokenizer on first use."""
   324→        if self._model is not None:
   325→            return
   326→
   327→        try:
   328→            import torch
   329→            from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
   330→        except ImportError as exc:
   331→            raise ImportError(
   332→                "Local MedGemma backend requires torch, transformers, and "
   333→                "accelerate installed. Install with: "
   334→                "pip install torch transformers accelerate bitsandbytes"
   335→            ) from exc
   336→
   337→        if not torch.cuda.is_available():
   338→            raise RuntimeError(
   339→                "Local MedGemma backend requires an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA. "
   340→                "No CUDA device detected. Use MODEL_BACKEND=vertex for "
   341→                "cloud-based inference instead."
   342→            )
   343→
   344→        logger.info(
   345→            "Loading MedGemma locally: model=%s, quantization=%s",
   346→            self.model_path,
   347→            self.quantization,
   348→        )
   349→
   350→        model_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
   351→            "device_map": "auto",
   352→            "torch_dtype": torch.bfloat16,
   353→        }
   354→
   355→        if self.quantization in ("4bit", "8bit"):
   356→            try:
   357→                from transformers import BitsAndBytesConfig
   358→            except ImportError as exc:
   359→                raise ImportError(
   360→                    "Quantized loading requires bitsandbytes. "
   361→                    "Install with: pip install bitsandbytes"
   362→                ) from exc
   363→
   364→            if self.quantization == "4bit":
   365→                model_kwargs["quantization_config"] = BitsAndBytesConfig(
   366→                    load_in_4bit=True,
   367→                    bnb_4bit_compute_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
   368→                    bnb_4bit_use_double_quant=True,
   369→                    bnb_4bit_quant_type="nf4",
   370→                )
   371→            else:
   372→                model_kwargs["quantization_config"] = BitsAndBytesConfig(
   373→                    load_in_8bit=True,
   374→                )
   375→
   376→        start_time = time.time()
   377→        self._tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.model_path)
   378→        self._model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
   379→            self.model_path, **model_kwargs
   380→        )
   381→        duration = time.time() - start_time
   382→        logger.info("MedGemma loaded in %.1f seconds", duration)
   383→
   384→    def _generate(
   385→        self,
   386→        messages: list[BaseMessage],
   387→        stop: list[str] | None = None,
   388→        run_manager: CallbackManagerForLLMRun | None = None,
   389→        **kwargs: Any,
   390→    ) -> ChatResult:
   391→        """Generate a response using the locally-loaded MedGemma model.
   392→
   393→        Args:
   394→            messages: List of LangChain messages.
   395→            stop: Optional stop sequences.
   396→            run_manager: Optional callback manager.
   397→            **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments (e.g. temperature).
   398→
   399→        Returns:
   400→            ChatResult containing the model's response.
   401→        """
   402→        import torch
   403→
   404→        self._ensure_loaded()
   405→
   406→        full_prompt = _build_gemma_prompt(messages)
   407→
   408→        inputs = self._tokenizer(full_prompt, return_tensors="pt").to(
   409→            self._model.device
   410→        )
   411→        input_length = inputs["input_ids"].shape[1]
   412→
   413→        start_time = time.time()
   414→        with torch.no_grad():
   415→            outputs = self._model.generate(
   416→                **inputs,
   417→                max_new_tokens=self.max_output_tokens,
   418→                temperature=kwargs.get("temperature", 0.1),
   419→                top_p=0.95,
   420→                top_k=40,
   421→                do_sample=True,
   422→            )
   423→        duration = time.time() - start_time
   424→
   425→        # Decode only the generated tokens (exclude prompt)
   426→        generated_tokens = outputs[0][input_length:]
   427→        text = self._tokenizer.decode(generated_tokens, skip_special_tokens=True)
   428→        text = _strip_model_garden_artifacts(text, full_prompt)
   429→
   430→        logger.debug(
   431→            "Local MedGemma generated %d tokens in %.2f seconds",
   432→            len(generated_tokens),
   433→            duration,
   434→        )
   435→
   436→        message = AIMessage(content=text)
   437→        generation = ChatGeneration(message=message)
   438→        return ChatResult(generations=[generation])
   439→
   440→    @property
   441→    def _llm_type(self) -> str:
   442→        return "local_medgemma"

   445→def create_model_loader(config: AgentConfig | None = None) -> Callable[[], Any]:
   446→    """Create a lazy MedGemma model loader for the configured backend.
   447→
   448→    Supports two backends:
   449→        - ``vertex``: Vertex AI Model Garden (cloud, recommended for production)
   450→        - ``local``: Local GPU with HuggingFace transformers (requires NVIDIA GPU)
   451→
   452→    Args:
   453→        config: Agent configuration. Defaults to ``AgentConfig.from_env()``.
   454→
   455→    Returns:
   456→        Callable that loads and returns a LangChain chat model when invoked.
   457→
   458→    Raises:
   459→        ValueError: If required configuration is missing for the selected backend.
   460→    """
   461→    cfg = config or AgentConfig.from_env()
   462→
   463→    if cfg.backend == "vertex":
   464→        return _create_vertex_model_loader(cfg)
   465→
   466→    return _create_local_model_loader(cfg)
   467→
   468→
   469→def _create_vertex_model_loader(cfg: AgentConfig) -> Callable[[], Any]:
   470→    """Create a lazy Vertex AI model loader.
   471→
   472→    Args:
   473→        cfg: Validated AgentConfig with backend=="vertex".
   474→
   475→    Returns:
   476→        Callable that lazily initializes and returns the model.
   477→    """
   478→    project_id, region, endpoint_id, vertex_model_name = _validate_vertex_config(cfg)
   479→
   480→    @lazy_singleton
   481→    def load_model() -> Any:
   482→        try:
   483→            import vertexai
   484→        except ImportError as exc:
   485→            raise ImportError(
   486→                "Vertex AI backend requires google-cloud-aiplatform installed."
   487→            ) from exc
   488→
   489→        vertexai.init(project=project_id, location=region)
   490→
   491→        if vertex_model_name:
   492→            try:
   493→                from langchain_google_genai import ChatGoogleGenerativeAI
   494→            except ImportError as exc:
   495→                raise ImportError(
   496→                    "Vertex AI backend requires langchain-google-genai installed."
   497→                ) from exc
   498→
   499→            return ChatGoogleGenerativeAI(
   500→                model=vertex_model_name,
   501→                project=project_id,
   502→                location=region,
   503→                vertexai=True,
   504→                max_output_tokens=cfg.max_new_tokens,
   505→            )
   506→
   507→        endpoint_resource_name = (
   508→            f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{region}/endpoints/{endpoint_id}"
   509→        )
   510→        return ModelGardenChatModel(
   511→            endpoint_resource_name=endpoint_resource_name,
   512→            project=project_id,
   513→            location=region,
   514→            max_output_tokens=cfg.max_new_tokens,
   515→        )
   516→
   517→    return load_model
   518→
   519→
   520→def _create_local_model_loader(cfg: AgentConfig) -> Callable[[], Any]:
   521→    """Create a lazy local MedGemma model loader.
   522→
   523→    Loads MedGemma (default: google/medgemma-4b-it) from HuggingFace
   524→    with optional 4-bit or 8-bit quantization via bitsandbytes.

   527→        cfg: AgentConfig with backend=="local".
   528→
   529→    Returns:
   530→        Callable that lazily initializes and returns the model.
   531→    """
   532→
   533→    @lazy_singleton
   534→    def load_model() -> Any:
   535→        logger.info(
   536→            "Initializing local MedGemma: model=%s, quantization=%s",
   537→            cfg.model_path,
   538→            cfg.quantization,
   539→        )
   540→        return LocalMedGemmaChatModel(
   541→            model_path=cfg.model_path,

1→"""Gemini extractor tool: structured criteria extraction via Gemini File API.
     2→
     3→Uploads PDF to Gemini File API, calls Gemini with structured output using
     4→ExtractionResult as the response schema, and returns a JSON string.
     5→
     6→Returns JSON string (not dict) to minimize LangGraph state size.
     7→"""
     8→
     9→from __future__ import annotations
    10→
    11→import logging
    12→import os
    13→import tempfile
    14→from pathlib import Path
    15→from typing import Any, cast
    16→
    17→from google import genai
    18→from google.genai import types
    19→from inference.factory import render_prompts
    20→from pydantic import ValidationError
    21→from shared.resilience import gemini_breaker
    22→from tenacity import (
    23→    before_sleep_log,
    24→    retry,
    25→    retry_if_exception_type,
    26→    stop_after_attempt,
    27→    wait_random_exponential,
    28→)
    29→
    30→from protocol_processor.schemas.extraction import ExtractionResult
    31→
    32→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    33→
    34→PROMPTS_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "prompts"
    35→
    36→# Max length when formatting validation errors (avoids huge console dumps)
    37→_VALIDATION_ERROR_STR_MAX = 200
    38→
    39→
    40→def _truncate(s: str, max_len: int = _VALIDATION_ERROR_STR_MAX) -> str:
    41→    """Truncate string for safe inclusion in error messages."""
    42→    if len(s) <= max_len:
    43→        return s
    44→    return s[:max_len] + "..."
    45→
    46→
    47→def _format_validation_error(err: ValidationError) -> str:
    48→    """Format ValidationError with truncated input/context for safe logging."""
    49→    errors = err.errors()
    50→    parts = [f"ValidationError ({len(errors)} error(s))"]
    51→    for e in errors:
    52→        loc = ".".join(str(x) for x in e.get("loc", ()))
    53→        msg = e.get("msg", "")
    54→        ctx = e.get("ctx") or {}
    55→        inp = e.get("input")
    56→        part = f"  {loc}: {msg}"
    57→        if ctx:
    58→            part += f" (ctx: {_truncate(str(ctx))})"
    59→        if inp is not None:
    60→            part += f" | input: {_truncate(str(inp))}"
    61→        parts.append(part)
    62→    return "\n".join(parts)
    63→
    64→
    65→@gemini_breaker
    66→@retry(
    67→    retry=retry_if_exception_type(Exception),
    68→    stop=stop_after_attempt(3),
    69→    wait=wait_random_exponential(multiplier=1, min=2, max=10),
    70→    before_sleep=before_sleep_log(logger, logging.WARNING),
    71→    reraise=True,
    72→)
    73→async def _invoke_gemini(
    74→    client: genai.Client,
    75→    model: str,
    76→    uploaded_file: types.File,
    77→    system_prompt: str,
    78→    user_prompt: str,
    79→) -> ExtractionResult:
    80→    """Invoke Gemini with retry and circuit breaker.
    81→
    82→    Args:
    83→        client: Google GenAI client instance.
    84→        model: Model name to use.
    85→        uploaded_file: Uploaded PDF file from File API.
    86→        system_prompt: System instruction.
    87→        user_prompt: User prompt text.
    88→
    89→    Returns:
    90→        ExtractionResult parsed from Gemini's structured output.
    91→    """
    92→    response = await client.aio.models.generate_content(
    93→        model=model,
    94→        contents=cast(Any, [uploaded_file, user_prompt]),
    95→        config=types.GenerateContentConfig(
    96→            system_instruction=system_prompt,
    97→            response_mime_type="application/json",
    98→            response_schema=ExtractionResult,
    99→        ),
   100→    )
   101→
   102→    # Return parsed Pydantic model directly
   103→    if response.parsed is not None:
   104→        return cast(ExtractionResult, response.parsed)
   105→
   106→    # Fallback to parsing response.text if parsed is None
   107→    text = response.text or ""
   108→    return ExtractionResult.model_validate_json(text)
   109→
   110→
   111→async def extract_criteria_structured(
   112→    pdf_bytes: bytes,
   113→    protocol_id: str,
   114→    title: str,
   115→) -> str:
   116→    """Extract criteria from PDF using Gemini File API with structured output.
   117→
   118→    Uploads the PDF to Gemini File API, calls Gemini with ExtractionResult
   119→    as the response schema, and returns the result as a JSON string.
   120→
   121→    Returns JSON string (not dict) to minimize LangGraph state size.
   122→
   123→    Args:
   124→        pdf_bytes: Raw PDF bytes to extract criteria from.
   125→        protocol_id: UUID of the protocol (for logging).
   126→        title: Protocol title (used in user prompt).
   127→
   128→    Returns:
   129→        JSON string representation of ExtractionResult.
   130→
   131→    Raises:
   132→        ValidationError: If Gemini response cannot be parsed as ExtractionResult.
   133→        Exception: On Gemini API or File API errors after retries exhausted.
   134→    """
   135→    tmp_path = None
   136→    uploaded_file = None
   137→    client = None
   138→
   139→    try:
   140→        # Instantiate client
   141→        client = genai.Client(api_key=os.getenv("GOOGLE_API_KEY"))
   142→        model_name = os.getenv("GEMINI_MODEL_NAME", "gemini-2.5-flash")
   143→
   144→        # Write PDF to temp file for File API upload
   145→        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".pdf", delete=False) as tmp:
   146→            tmp.write(pdf_bytes)
   147→            tmp_path = tmp.name
   148→
   149→        # Upload via File API
   150→        uploaded_file = client.files.upload(file=tmp_path)
   151→
   152→        system_prompt, user_prompt = render_prompts(
   153→            prompts_dir=PROMPTS_DIR,
   154→            system_template="system.jinja2",
   155→            user_template="user.jinja2",
   156→            prompt_vars={
   157→                "title": title,
   158→            },
   159→        )
   160→
   161→        extraction_result = await _invoke_gemini(
   162→            client, model_name, uploaded_file, system_prompt, user_prompt
   163→        )
   164→
   165→        logger.info(
   166→            "Extracted %d criteria from protocol %s (Gemini File API)",
   167→            len(extraction_result.criteria),
   168→            protocol_id,
   169→        )
   170→
   171→        # Return as JSON string (not dict) for minimal state
   172→        return extraction_result.model_dump_json()
   173→
   174→    except ValidationError as e:
   175→        msg = _format_validation_error(e)
   176→        logger.error(
   177→            "Extraction validation failed for protocol %s: %s",
   178→            protocol_id,
   179→            msg,
   180→        )
   181→        raise
   182→
   183→    except Exception:
   184→        logger.exception(
   185→            "Extraction failed for protocol %s",
   186→            protocol_id,
   187→        )
   188→        raise
   189→
   190→    finally:
   191→        # Clean up temp file
   192→        if tmp_path:
   193→            try:
   194→                os.unlink(tmp_path)
   195→            except Exception as cleanup_err:
   196→                logger.warning(
   197→                    "Failed to delete temp file %s: %s", tmp_path, cleanup_err
   198→                )
   199→
   200→        # Clean up uploaded file
   201→        if uploaded_file and client and uploaded_file.name:
   202→            try:
   203→                client.files.delete(name=uploaded_file.name)
   204→            except Exception as cleanup_err:
   205→                logger.warning(
   206→                    "Failed to delete uploaded file %s: %s",
   207→                    uploaded_file.name,
   208→                    cleanup_err,
   209→                )
   210→

1→"""MedGemma decision tool for best-match selection from TerminologyRouter candidates.
     2→
     3→Per user decision: "MedGemma acts as decision-maker, minimum token usage."
     4→MedGemma evaluates candidates returned by TerminologyRouter and selects the best
     5→match for each entity. Uses the two-model architecture: MedGemma for medical
     6→reasoning, Gemini for structured output parsing.
     7→"""
     8→
     9→from __future__ import annotations
    10→
    11→import logging
    12→import os
    13→from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
    14→
    15→if TYPE_CHECKING:
    16→    from protocol_processor.tools.terminology_router import TerminologyRouter
    17→
    18→from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage, SystemMessage
    19→from langchain_google_genai import ChatGoogleGenerativeAI
    20→from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
    21→
    22→from protocol_processor.schemas.grounding import (
    23→    EntityGroundingResult,
    24→    GroundingCandidate,
    25→)
    26→
    27→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    28→
    29→_model_loader = None
    30→_PROMPTS_DIR = None
    31→
    32→
    33→def _get_prompts_dir():
    34→    from pathlib import Path
    35→
    36→    return Path(__file__).parent.parent / "prompts"
    37→
    38→
    39→def _render_template(template_name: str, **kwargs: Any) -> str:
    40→    """Render a Jinja2 template from the prompts directory."""
    41→    from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader
    42→
    43→    prompts_dir = _get_prompts_dir()
    44→    env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(str(prompts_dir)), autoescape=False)
    45→    template = env.get_template(template_name)
    46→    return template.render(**kwargs)
    47→
    48→
    49→class AgenticReasoningResult(BaseModel):
    50→    """MedGemma's 3-question reasoning output for failed grounding retry.
    51→
    52→    Used by agentic_reasoning_loop to determine whether to skip an entity,
    53→    apply derived entity mapping, or rephrase the query for a better search.
    54→
    55→    Attributes:
    56→        should_skip: True if entity is not a valid medical criterion.
    57→        is_derived: True if entity maps to a more standard medical concept.
    58→        derived_term: Standard concept term if is_derived is True.
    59→        rephrased_query: Rephrased medical terminology query if applicable.
    60→        gemini_suggestion: Optional additional reformulation from Gemini.
    61→        reasoning: Brief explanation of the reasoning decisions.
    62→    """
    63→
    64→    should_skip: bool = Field(
    65→        default=False,
    66→        description=(
    67→            "True if entity is not a valid medical criterion "
    68→            "(e.g., consent, participation, willingness)"
    69→        ),
    70→    )
    71→    is_derived: bool = Field(
    72→        default=False,
    73→        description="True if entity maps to a more standard medical concept",
    74→    )
    75→    derived_term: str | None = Field(
    76→        default=None,
    77→        description=(
    78→            "Standard concept term if is_derived is True "
    79→            "(e.g., 'age' for 'age >= 18 years')"
    80→        ),
    81→    )
    82→    rephrased_query: str | None = Field(
    83→        default=None,
    84→        description=(
    85→            "Rephrased medical terminology query for better search "
    86→            "(e.g., 'hypertension' for 'high blood pressure')"
    87→        ),
    88→    )
    89→    gemini_suggestion: str | None = Field(
    90→        default=None,
    91→        description=("Optional reformulation suggestion from Gemini structuring step"),
    92→    )
    93→    reasoning: str = Field(
    94→        default="",
    95→        description="Brief explanation of the three-question reasoning",
    96→    )
    97→
    98→
    99→class GroundingDecision(BaseModel):
   100→    """MedGemma's decision for the best terminology match."""
   101→
   102→    selected_code: str | None = Field(
   103→        default=None,
   104→        description=(
   105→            "Selected terminology code (CUI for UMLS, SNOMED code, etc)."
   106→            " Null if no good match."
   107→        ),
   108→    )
   109→    selected_system: str | None = Field(
   110→        default=None,
   111→        description=(
   112→            "The API/system that produced the selected code (e.g. 'umls', 'snomed')."
   113→        ),
   114→    )
   115→    preferred_term: str | None = Field(
   116→        default=None,
   117→        description="Canonical preferred term for the selected code.",
   118→    )
   119→    confidence: float = Field(
   120→        ge=0.0,
   121→        le=1.0,
   122→        description=(
   123→            "Confidence score 0.0-1.0."
   124→            " 0.9-1.0=exact, 0.7-0.8=synonym, 0.5-0.6=partial, 0.0=no match."
   125→        ),
   126→    )
   127→    reasoning: str = Field(
   128→        default="",
   129→        description="Brief explanation for selection.",
   130→    )
   131→
   132→
   133→def _get_medgemma_model() -> Any:
   134→    """Get or create MedGemma model instance."""
   135→    global _model_loader  # noqa: PLW0603
   136→    if _model_loader is None:
   137→        from inference.config import AgentConfig
   138→        from inference.model_garden import create_model_loader
   139→
   140→        _model_loader = create_model_loader(AgentConfig.from_env())
   141→    return _model_loader()
   142→
   143→
   144→async def _structure_decision_with_gemini(raw_text: str) -> GroundingDecision:
   145→    """Structure raw MedGemma output using Gemini with_structured_output.
   146→
   147→    Args:
   148→        raw_text: Raw MedGemma output (free-form medical reasoning).
   149→
   150→    Returns:
   151→        GroundingDecision with selected code and confidence.
   152→    """
   153→    gemini_model_name = os.getenv("GEMINI_MODEL_NAME", "gemini-2.5-flash")
   154→    google_api_key = os.getenv("GOOGLE_API_KEY")
   155→
   156→    if not google_api_key:
   157→        raise ValueError("GOOGLE_API_KEY environment variable is required")
   158→
   159→    gemini = ChatGoogleGenerativeAI(
   160→        model=gemini_model_name,
   161→        google_api_key=google_api_key,
   162→    )
   163→    structured_llm = gemini.with_structured_output(GroundingDecision)
   164→
   165→    prompt = (
   166→        "Extract the grounding decision from this medical terminology analysis."
   167→        " Return the selected code, system, preferred term, confidence,"
   168→        f" and reasoning.\n\n{raw_text}"
   169→    )
   170→
   171→    result = await structured_llm.ainvoke(prompt)
   172→    if isinstance(result, dict):
   173→        return GroundingDecision.model_validate(result)
   174→    return result  # type: ignore[return-value]
   175→
   176→
   177→async def medgemma_decide(
   178→    entity: dict,
   179→    candidates: list[GroundingCandidate],
   180→    criterion_context: str,
   181→) -> EntityGroundingResult:
   182→    """Use MedGemma to select the best terminology match for an entity.
   183→
   184→    MedGemma evaluates the candidates returned by TerminologyRouter and
   185→    selects the most appropriate code for the entity. Returns a result with
   186→    confidence=0.0 and no code if no candidates are available or none are
   187→    appropriate.
   188→
   189→    Args:
   190→        entity: Entity dict with keys: text, entity_type, criterion_id.
   191→        candidates: List of GroundingCandidate objects from TerminologyRouter.
   192→        criterion_context: The full criterion text for context.
   193→
   194→    Returns:
   195→        EntityGroundingResult with the selected code, confidence, and reasoning.
   196→    """
   197→    entity_text = entity.get("text", "")
   198→    entity_type = entity.get("entity_type", "")
   199→    criterion_id = entity.get("criterion_id", "")
   200→
   201→    # If no candidates, return result with confidence=0.0
   202→    if not candidates:
   203→        logger.info(
   204→            "No candidates for entity '%s' (type=%s, criterion=%s)"
   205→            " — returning empty grounding",
   206→            entity_text[:50],
   207→            entity_type,
   208→            criterion_id[:12],
   209→        )
   210→        return EntityGroundingResult(
   211→            entity_text=entity_text,
   212→            entity_type=entity_type,
   213→            selected_code=None,
   214→            selected_system=None,
   215→            preferred_term=None,
   216→            confidence=0.0,
   217→            candidates=[],
   218→            reasoning="No terminology candidates available from any API",
   219→        )
   220→
   221→    try:
   222→        model = _get_medgemma_model()
   223→
   224→        system_prompt = _render_template("grounding_system.jinja2")
   225→        evaluate_prompt = _render_template(
   226→            "grounding_evaluate.jinja2",
   227→            entity_text=entity_text,
   228→            entity_type=entity_type,
   229→            criterion_context=criterion_context,
   230→            candidates=candidates,
   231→        )
   232→
   233→        messages = [
   234→            SystemMessage(content=system_prompt),
   235→            HumanMessage(content=evaluate_prompt),
   236→        ]
   237→        raw_response = await model.ainvoke(messages)
   238→        raw_text = raw_response.content
   239→
   240→        logger.debug(
   241→            "MedGemma evaluate response for '%s' (first 200 chars): %s",
   242→            entity_text[:30],
   243→            raw_text[:200],
   244→        )
   245→
   246→        decision = await _structure_decision_with_gemini(raw_text)
   247→
   248→        logger.info(
   249→            "Grounding decision for '%s': code=%s, system=%s, conf=%.2f",
   250→            entity_text[:50],
   251→            decision.selected_code,
   252→            decision.selected_system,
   253→            decision.confidence,
   254→        )
   255→
   256→        return EntityGroundingResult(
   257→            entity_text=entity_text,
   258→            entity_type=entity_type,
   259→            selected_code=decision.selected_code,
   260→            selected_system=decision.selected_system,
   261→            preferred_term=decision.preferred_term,
   262→            confidence=decision.confidence,
   263→            candidates=candidates,
   264→            reasoning=decision.reasoning,
   265→        )
   266→
   267→    except Exception as e:
   268→        logger.error(
   269→            "MedGemma decision failed for entity '%s': %s",
   270→            entity_text[:50],
   271→            e,
   272→            exc_info=True,
   273→        )
   274→        return EntityGroundingResult(
   275→            entity_text=entity_text,
   276→            entity_type=entity_type,
   277→            selected_code=None,
   278→            selected_system=None,
   279→            preferred_term=None,
   280→            confidence=0.0,
   281→            candidates=candidates,
   282→            reasoning=f"MedGemma decision failed: {e}",
   283→        )
   284→
   285→
   286→async def _structure_reasoning_with_gemini(raw_text: str) -> AgenticReasoningResult:
   287→    """Structure raw MedGemma reasoning output using Gemini with_structured_output.
   288→
   289→    Gemini also acts as a collaborating agent here — it can add its own
   290→    reformulation suggestions via the gemini_suggestion field when structuring
   291→    the output.
   292→
   293→    Args:
   294→        raw_text: Raw MedGemma reasoning output (free-form text).
   295→
   296→    Returns:
   297→        AgenticReasoningResult with structured 3-question answers.
   298→    """
   299→    gemini_model_name = os.getenv("GEMINI_MODEL_NAME", "gemini-2.5-flash")
   300→    google_api_key = os.getenv("GOOGLE_API_KEY")
   301→
   302→    if not google_api_key:
   303→        raise ValueError("GOOGLE_API_KEY environment variable is required")
   304→
   305→    gemini = ChatGoogleGenerativeAI(
   306→        model=gemini_model_name,
   307→        google_api_key=google_api_key,
   308→    )
   309→    structured_llm = gemini.with_structured_output(AgenticReasoningResult)
   310→
   311→    prompt = (
   312→        "Extract the structured reasoning from this medical entity analysis. "
   313→        "Determine: (1) should_skip if entity is not a valid medical criterion, "
   314→        "(2) is_derived and derived_term if entity maps to a standard concept, "
   315→        "(3) rephrased_query if a better medical term would improve search. "
   316→        "You may also add a gemini_suggestion with your own reformulation if "
   317→        "you can improve on the analysis.\n\n"
   318→        f"{raw_text}"
   319→    )
   320→
   321→    result = await structured_llm.ainvoke(prompt)
   322→    if isinstance(result, dict):
   323→        return AgenticReasoningResult.model_validate(result)
   324→    return result  # type: ignore[return-value]
   325→
   326→
   327→async def agentic_reasoning_loop(
   328→    entity: dict,
   329→    criterion_context: str,
   330→    router: "TerminologyRouter",
   331→    attempt: int = 1,
   332→) -> AgenticReasoningResult:
   333→    """Ask MedGemma 3 reasoning questions to determine retry strategy.
   334→
   335→    Called by ground_node when an entity fails initial grounding (zero
   336→    candidates or confidence < 0.5). Asks MedGemma in a single prompt:
   337→    - Q1: Is this a valid medical criterion (or should it be skipped)?
   338→    - Q2: Is this a derived entity that maps to a standard concept?
   339→    - Q3: Can this entity be rephrased for better terminology search?
   340→
   341→    Uses the two-model architecture: MedGemma for medical reasoning, Gemini
   342→    for structured output parsing (and optional reformulation suggestion).
   343→
   344→    Args:
   345→        entity: Entity dict with keys: text, entity_type, criterion_id.
   346→        criterion_context: The full criterion text for context.
   347→        router: TerminologyRouter instance (for get_apis_for_entity context).
   348→        attempt: Current attempt number (1-3) for prompt context.
   349→
   350→    Returns:
   351→        AgenticReasoningResult with should_skip, is_derived, derived_term,
   352→        rephrased_query, gemini_suggestion, and reasoning fields.
   353→        On error, returns default result (no skip, no rephrase) to allow
   354→        the retry loop to continue with the original query.
   355→    """
   356→    entity_text = entity.get("text", "")
   357→    entity_type = entity.get("entity_type", "")
   358→    previous_query = entity.get("_previous_query", entity_text)
   359→
   360→    logger.info(
   361→        "Agentic reasoning (attempt %d) for entity '%s' (type=%s)",
   362→        attempt,
   363→        entity_text[:50],
   364→        entity_type,
   365→    )
   366→
   367→    try:
   368→        model = _get_medgemma_model()
   369→
   370→        system_prompt = _render_template("grounding_system.jinja2")
   371→        reasoning_prompt = _render_template(
   372→            "grounding_reasoning.jinja2",
   373→            entity_text=entity_text,
   374→            entity_type=entity_type,
   375→            criterion_context=criterion_context,
   376→            previous_query=previous_query,
   377→            attempt=attempt,
   378→        )
   379→
   380→        messages = [
   381→            SystemMessage(content=system_prompt),
   382→            HumanMessage(content=reasoning_prompt),
   383→        ]
   384→        raw_response = await model.ainvoke(messages)
   385→        raw_text = raw_response.content
   386→
   387→        logger.debug(
   388→            "MedGemma reasoning response for '%s' (first 300 chars): %s",
   389→            entity_text[:30],
   390→            raw_text[:300],
   391→        )
   392→
   393→        result = await _structure_reasoning_with_gemini(raw_text)
   394→
   395→        logger.info(
   396→            "Agentic reasoning result for '%s': skip=%s, derived=%s, "
   397→            "derived_term=%s, rephrased=%s",
   398→            entity_text[:50],
   399→            result.should_skip,
   400→            result.is_derived,
   401→            result.derived_term,
   402→            result.rephrased_query,
   403→        )
   404→
   405→        return result
   406→
   407→    except Exception as e:
   408→        logger.error(
   409→            "Agentic reasoning loop failed for entity '%s': %s",
   410→            entity_text[:50],
   411→            e,
   412→            exc_info=True,
   413→        )
   414→        # Return default result (no skip, no rephrase) — retry with original query
   415→        return AgenticReasoningResult(
   416→            should_skip=False,
   417→            is_derived=False,
   418→            derived_term=None,
   419→            rephrased_query=None,
   420→            reasoning=f"Reasoning loop failed: {e}",
   421→        )
   422→

1→"""TerminologyRouter: entity-type-aware routing to terminology APIs via ToolUniverse.
     2→
     3→Routes entities to terminology APIs based on entity type using a YAML config.
     4→All 6 systems (UMLS, SNOMED, ICD-10, LOINC, RxNorm, HPO) are accessed via the
     5→ToolUniverse SDK singleton in tooluniverse_client.py.
     6→
     7→Per user decisions:
     8→- Entity type → API mapping stored in config file (YAML), not hardcoded.
     9→- All terminology systems accessed via ToolUniverse SDK (single dependency).
    10→- On API failure: retry transient errors; continue on permanent failures.
    11→- Consent entities explicitly skipped with logging.
    12→- Demographic entities routed normally (not skipped); MedGemma handles derived
    13→  entity mapping (age → birthDate concept, gender → SNOMED gender concepts).
    14→
    15→See config/routing.yaml for the entity type → API mapping.
    16→"""
    17→
    18→from __future__ import annotations
    19→
    20→import logging
    21→from pathlib import Path
    22→
    23→import yaml
    24→from platformdirs import user_cache_dir
    25→from tenacity import (
    26→    before_sleep_log,
    27→    retry,
    28→    retry_if_exception_type,
    29→    stop_after_attempt,
    30→    wait_random_exponential,
    31→)
    32→
    33→from protocol_processor.schemas.grounding import GroundingCandidate
    34→
    35→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    36→
    37→# Default routing config path relative to this file
    38→_DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATH = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "config" / "routing.yaml"
    39→
    40→# diskcache TTL: 7 days in seconds
    41→_CACHE_TTL = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60
    42→
    43→
    44→def _get_cache():
    45→    """Get or create the diskcache Cache instance.
    46→
    47→    Returns:
    48→        diskcache.Cache instance stored in user cache dir, or None if
    49→        diskcache is not installed.
    50→    """
    51→    try:
    52→        import diskcache
    53→
    54→        cache_dir = Path(user_cache_dir("medgemma-terminology-router"))
    55→        return diskcache.Cache(str(cache_dir))
    56→    except ImportError:
    57→        logger.debug("diskcache not installed — terminology API caching disabled.")
    58→        return None
    59→
    60→
    61→class TransientAPIError(Exception):
    62→    """Retriable API failure: rate limit (429), timeout (408), server error (5xx).
    63→
    64→    TerminologyRouter retries these automatically with exponential backoff.
    65→    """
    66→
    67→
    68→class PermanentAPIError(Exception):
    69→    """Non-retriable API failure: auth error (401/403), validation (400/422).
    70→
    71→    TerminologyRouter logs and skips these — retrying cannot fix them.
    72→    """
    73→
    74→
    75→class TerminologyRouter:
    76→    """Route entities to terminology APIs via ToolUniverse SDK.
    77→
    78→    Loads entity type → API mapping from routing.yaml. For each entity,
    79→    queries all matching APIs via the ToolUniverse singleton client and
    80→    returns a list of GroundingCandidate objects. MedGemma then selects
    81→    the best match downstream.
    82→
    83→    Implements error accumulation: individual API failures are logged and
    84→    skipped, not propagated. The entity is still grounded by remaining APIs.
    85→
    86→    Usage:
    87→        router = TerminologyRouter()
    88→        candidates = await router.route_entity("metformin", "Medication")
    89→        # candidates: [GroundingCandidate(source_api="rxnorm", ...), ...]
    90→
    91→    Attributes:
    92→        config: Parsed YAML config dict.
    93→        config_path: Path to the routing.yaml file used.
    94→    """
    95→
    96→    def __init__(self, config_path: Path | None = None) -> None:
    97→        """Initialize TerminologyRouter with routing config.
    98→
    99→        Args:
   100→            config_path: Path to routing.yaml. Defaults to config/routing.yaml
   101→                relative to this package.
   102→        """
   103→        self.config_path = config_path or _DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATH
   104→        with open(self.config_path) as f:
   105→            self.config: dict = yaml.safe_load(f)
   106→
   107→    def get_apis_for_entity(self, entity_type: str) -> list[str]:
   108→        """Get list of API names to query for this entity type.
   109→
   110→        Returns an empty list for entity types with skip: true in routing config
   111→        (e.g. Consent) and for entity types not found in the routing config.
   112→        Both cases are logged.
   113→
   114→        Args:
   115→            entity_type: Entity type string (e.g. "Medication", "Condition").
   116→
   117→        Returns:
   118→            List of API names to query, or empty list if entity should be skipped.
   119→        """
   120→        routing_rules: dict = self.config.get("routing_rules", {})
   121→        rule = routing_rules.get(entity_type)
   122→
   123→        if rule is None:
   124→            logger.warning(
   125→                "Unknown entity type '%s' — not in routing config. "
   126→                "Skipping grounding. Add to config/routing.yaml to enable.",
   127→                entity_type,
   128→            )
   129→            return []
   130→
   131→        # Explicit skip (e.g. Consent: {skip: true})
   132→        if isinstance(rule, dict) and rule.get("skip"):
   133→            logger.info(
   134→                "Entity type '%s' is explicitly skipped in routing config "
   135→                "(no terminology grounding for this type).",
   136→                entity_type,
   137→            )
   138→            return []
   139→
   140→        if isinstance(rule, list):
   141→            return rule
   142→
   143→        # Unexpected rule format — treat as unknown
   144→        logger.warning(
   145→            "Unexpected routing rule format for '%s': %r. Skipping.",
   146→            entity_type,
   147→            rule,
   148→        )
   149→        return []
   150→
   151→    async def route_entity(
   152→        self, entity_text: str, entity_type: str
   153→    ) -> list[GroundingCandidate]:
   154→        """Route entity to all matching APIs and return all candidates.
   155→
   156→        Queries each API configured for the entity type via ToolUniverse SDK.
   157→        Individual API failures are logged and skipped (error accumulation).
   158→        The caller (MedGemma ground node) receives all available candidates
   159→        and selects the best match.
   160→
   161→        Args:
   162→            entity_text: The entity text to look up (e.g. "metformin").
   163→            entity_type: The entity type (e.g. "Medication").
   164→
   165→        Returns:
   166→            List of GroundingCandidate objects from all queried APIs.
   167→            Empty list if entity type is skipped or all APIs fail.
   168→        """
   169→        api_names = self.get_apis_for_entity(entity_type)
   170→
   171→        if not api_names:
   172→            return []
   173→
   174→        all_candidates: list[GroundingCandidate] = []
   175→
   176→        for api_name in api_names:
   177→            try:
   178→                candidates = await self._query_tooluniverse(api_name, entity_text)
   179→                all_candidates.extend(candidates)
   180→
   181→            except PermanentAPIError as e:
   182→                # Non-retriable: log and skip this API
   183→                logger.error(
   184→                    "Permanent API error from '%s' for entity '%s': %s",
   185→                    api_name,
   186→                    entity_text,
   187→                    e,
   188→                )
   189→            except Exception as e:
   190→                # Transient/unexpected: log and skip (tenacity already retried)
   191→                logger.error(
   192→                    "API '%s' failed for entity '%s' after retries: %s",
   193→                    api_name,
   194→                    entity_text,
   195→                    e,
   196→                )
   197→
   198→        return all_candidates
   199→
   200→    @retry(
   201→        retry=retry_if_exception_type(TransientAPIError),
   202→        stop=stop_after_attempt(3),
   203→        wait=wait_random_exponential(multiplier=1, min=2, max=10),
   204→        before_sleep=before_sleep_log(logger, logging.WARNING),
   205→        reraise=True,
   206→    )
   207→    async def _query_tooluniverse(
   208→        self, api_name: str, entity_text: str
   209→    ) -> list[GroundingCandidate]:
   210→        """Query terminology system via ToolUniverse client wrapper.
   211→
   212→        Uses the singleton search_terminology function which handles tool
   213→        dispatch, response parsing, and in-memory TTL caching.
   214→
   215→        Retries on TransientAPIError with exponential backoff (3 attempts max).
   216→
   217→        Args:
   218→            api_name: Terminology system name (e.g. "umls", "icd10").
   219→            entity_text: Term to search.
   220→
   221→        Returns:
   222→            List of GroundingCandidate objects from ToolUniverse.
   223→
   224→        Raises:
   225→            TransientAPIError: On retriable errors (rate limit, timeout, 5xx).
   226→        """
   227→        from protocol_processor.tools.tooluniverse_client import search_terminology
   228→
   229→        candidates = await search_terminology(api_name, entity_text, max_results=10)
   230→        return candidates
   231→

1→"""Shared Gemini LLM utilities for protocol processor tools.
     2→
     3→Centralizes the repeated pattern of creating a ChatGoogleGenerativeAI
     4→client with structured output and parsing its response. Used by
     5→structure_builder, ordinal_resolver, and field_mapper.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from __future__ import annotations
     9→
    10→import logging
    11→import os
    12→from typing import Any, TypeVar
    13→
    14→from pydantic import BaseModel
    15→
    16→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    17→
    18→T = TypeVar("T", bound=BaseModel)
    19→
    20→
    21→def create_structured_llm(
    22→    output_schema: type[T],
    23→) -> Any | None:
    24→    """Create a Gemini LLM client with structured output.
    25→
    26→    Guards on GOOGLE_API_KEY. Uses late import of ChatGoogleGenerativeAI
    27→    to avoid import errors when the package is not installed.
    28→
    29→    Args:
    30→        output_schema: Pydantic model class for structured output.
    31→
    32→    Returns:
    33→        A structured LLM instance, or None if GOOGLE_API_KEY is not set
    34→        or client creation fails.
    35→    """
    36→    google_api_key = os.getenv("GOOGLE_API_KEY")
    37→    if not google_api_key:
    38→        logger.warning("GOOGLE_API_KEY not set — skipping Gemini call")
    39→        return None
    40→
    41→    try:
    42→        from langchain_google_genai import ChatGoogleGenerativeAI
    43→
    44→        gemini_model_name = os.getenv("GEMINI_MODEL_NAME", "gemini-2.5-flash")
    45→        gemini = ChatGoogleGenerativeAI(
    46→            model=gemini_model_name,
    47→            google_api_key=google_api_key,
    48→        )
    49→        return gemini.with_structured_output(output_schema)
    50→    except Exception as e:
    51→        logger.warning("Failed to create Gemini client: %s", e)
    52→        return None
    53→
    54→
    55→def parse_structured_output(result: Any, model: type[T]) -> T:
    56→    """Parse a structured LLM output into a Pydantic model.
    57→
    58→    Handles both dict and already-parsed model instances returned
    59→    by LangChain's with_structured_output().
    60→
    61→    Args:
    62→        result: Raw LLM output (dict or model instance).
    63→        model: Pydantic model class to validate against.
    64→
    65→    Returns:
    66→        Validated model instance.
    67→    """
    68→    if isinstance(result, dict):
    69→        return model.model_validate(result)
    70→    return result  # type: ignore[return-value]
    71→

1→"""Pydantic models for Gemini structured output of criteria extraction.
     2→
     3→These models define the schema that Gemini's response_schema parameter uses
     4→to constrain JSON response output. Every field includes a Field(description=...)
     5→to guide the LLM's output generation.
     6→
     7→Nesting is kept to max 2 levels to avoid serialization issues.
     8→"""
     9→
    10→from enum import Enum
    11→from typing import Annotated, Literal
    12→
    13→from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
    14→
    15→# Max lengths to prevent model repetition/runaway output and keep errors readable
    16→MAX_CRITERION_TEXT_LEN = 12_000
    17→MAX_CONDITION_PHRASE_LEN = 400
    18→MAX_PROTOCOL_SUMMARY_LEN = 2_000
    19→
    20→
    21→class AssertionStatus(str, Enum):
    22→    """Assertion status for a clinical trial criterion.
    23→
    24→    Determines whether the criterion describes a condition that must be
    25→    present, absent, hypothetical, historical, or conditional.
    26→    """
    27→
    28→    PRESENT = "PRESENT"
    29→    ABSENT = "ABSENT"
    30→    HYPOTHETICAL = "HYPOTHETICAL"
    31→    HISTORICAL = "HISTORICAL"
    32→    CONDITIONAL = "CONDITIONAL"
    33→
    34→
    35→class TemporalConstraint(BaseModel):
    36→    """Temporal constraint on a criterion.
    37→
    38→    Captures time-based requirements such as "within 6 months of screening"
    39→    or "at least 4 weeks before enrollment".
    40→    """
    41→
    42→    duration: str | None = Field(
    43→        default=None,
    44→        description="Duration value, e.g., '6 months', '4 weeks', '30 days'",
    45→    )
    46→    relation: str | None = Field(
    47→        default=None,
    48→        description=("Temporal relation: 'within', 'before', 'after', or 'at_least'"),
    49→    )
    50→    reference_point: str | None = Field(
    51→        default=None,
    52→        description=(
    53→            "Reference point for the temporal constraint: "
    54→            "'screening', 'enrollment', 'diagnosis', or other timepoint"
    55→        ),
    56→    )
    57→
    58→
    59→class NumericThreshold(BaseModel):
    60→    """Numeric threshold for a criterion.
    61→
    62→    Captures lab values, age ranges, dosages, and other measurable
    63→    requirements such as "HbA1c < 8%" or "Age >= 18 years".
    64→    """
    65→
    66→    value: float = Field(
    67→        description=(
    68→            "The primary numeric value of the threshold "
    69→            "(e.g., 40 for 'age 40-85', 8 for 'HbA1c <8%', 150 for '>=150mg')"
    70→        ),
    71→    )
    72→    unit: str = Field(
    73→        description=(
    74→            "Unit of measurement, e.g., 'years', 'mg/dL', '%', "
    75→            "'kg/m2', 'WOMAC', 'ECOG', 'mg', 'mmol/L'"
    76→        ),
    77→    )
    78→    comparator: str = Field(
    79→        description=(
    80→            "Comparison operator: '>=' (greater than or equal), "
    81→            "'<=' (less than or equal), '>' (greater than), "
    82→            "'<' (less than), '==' (equals), or "
    83→            "'range' (between two values, requires upper_value)"
    84→        ),
    85→    )
    86→    upper_value: float | None = Field(
    87→        default=None,
    88→        description=(
    89→            "Upper bound value when comparator is 'range'. "
    90→            "Example: 'age 18-65 years' results in value=18, "
    91→            "upper_value=65, comparator='range'. "
    92→            "Only set when comparator='range'."
    93→        ),
    94→    )
    95→
    96→
    97→class ExtractedCriterion(BaseModel):
    98→    """A single extracted criterion from a clinical trial protocol.
    99→
   100→    Contains the full structured representation of one inclusion or
   101→    exclusion criterion, including temporal constraints, numeric
   102→    thresholds, assertion status, and confidence scoring.
   103→    """
   104→
   105→    text: str = Field(
   106→        max_length=MAX_CRITERION_TEXT_LEN,
   107→        description=(
   108→            "The original criterion text as written in the protocol. "
   109→            "Copy from the document; do not repeat or paraphrase instructions."
   110→        ),
   111→    )
   112→    criteria_type: Literal["inclusion", "exclusion"] = Field(
   113→        description="Whether this is an inclusion or exclusion criterion",
   114→    )
   115→    category: str | None = Field(
   116→        default=None,
   117→        description=(
   118→            "Category of the criterion: 'medical_history', "
   119→            "'lab_values', 'medications', 'procedures', or 'other'. "
   120→            "Do not use 'demographics' — demographic criteria are not grounded."
   121→        ),
   122→    )
   123→    temporal_constraint: TemporalConstraint | None = Field(
   124→        default=None,
   125→        description="Any temporal constraint on this criterion, if applicable",
   126→    )
   127→    conditions: list[Annotated[str, Field(REDACTED)]] = (
   128→        Field(
   129→            default_factory=list,
   130→            description=(
   131→                "Zero or more conditional phrases from the protocol only. "
   132→                "Look for markers: 'if', 'for patients who/with', 'when', "
   133→                "'in case of', 'provided that', 'unless'. "
   134→                "Each entry is ONE short phrase from the protocol. "
   135→                "Do not repeat; no instruction or placeholder text. "
   136→                "Leave empty [] if the criterion has no conditional dependency."
   137→            ),
   138→        )
   139→    )
   140→    numeric_thresholds: list[NumericThreshold] = Field(
   141→        default_factory=list,
   142→        description=(
   143→            "List of ALL numeric thresholds mentioned in the criterion. "
   144→            "Extract ALL numeric values with their units and comparison operators. "
   145→            "Common patterns: age ranges ('40 to 85 years' -> comparator='range'), "
   146→            "lab values ('HbA1c <8%' -> comparator='<'), "
   147→            "dosages ('>=150mg' -> comparator='>='), "
   148→            "scores ('WOMAC >=1.5' -> comparator='>='). "
   149→            "A single criterion may have multiple thresholds."
   150→        ),
   151→    )
   152→    assertion_status: AssertionStatus = Field(
   153→        description=(
   154→            "Assertion status: PRESENT means the condition must be true, "
   155→            "ABSENT means it must not be true, HYPOTHETICAL for future "
   156→            "conditions, HISTORICAL for past history, CONDITIONAL for "
   157→            "dependent conditions"
   158→        ),
   159→    )
   160→    confidence: float = Field(
   161→        ge=0.0,
   162→        le=1.0,
   163→        description=(
   164→            "Confidence score for this extraction (0.0 = very uncertain, "
   165→            "1.0 = very confident)"
   166→        ),
   167→    )
   168→    source_section: str | None = Field(
   169→        default=None,
   170→        description="Section header where this criterion was found in the protocol",
   171→    )
   172→    page_number: int | None = Field(
   173→        default=None,
   174→        description=(
   175→            "The 1-based page number in the PDF where this criterion appears. "
   176→            "Report the page where the criterion text begins. "
   177→            "If the criterion spans multiple pages, report the first page."
   178→        ),
   179→    )
   180→
   181→
   182→class ExtractionResult(BaseModel):
   183→    """Complete extraction result from a clinical trial protocol.
   184→
   185→    Contains all extracted inclusion and exclusion criteria along with
   186→    a brief summary of the protocol's purpose.
   187→    """
   188→
   189→    criteria: list[ExtractedCriterion] = Field(
   190→        description="All extracted inclusion and exclusion criteria",
   191→    )
   192→    protocol_summary: str = Field(
   193→        max_length=MAX_PROTOCOL_SUMMARY_LEN,
   194→        description=(
   195→            "Brief 1-2 sentence summary of the clinical trial's purpose "
   196→            "and target population"
   197→        ),
   198→    )
   199→
